pipelines.name: Build and Test

steps.name: Quality gate
steps.run:
if [[ "$EVENT" == "push" ]]; then
  mode="--overwrite-baseline"
elif [[ "$HEAD_REPOSITORY" != "$REPOSITORY" ]]; then
  mode="--bypass-format"
else
  mode=""
fi
./scripts/quality-gate/gate.sh packages $mode

with.title: chore(quality-gate): refresh baseline after merge
with.body: Refreshes the quality-gate baseline after a merge to master.

steps.name: Compare each changed baseline with the PR's base
steps.run:
verdict=0
while IFS= read -r file; do
  before="$RUNNER_TEMP/before.json"
  git show "$BASE:$file" > "$before" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$before"
  echo "== $file"
  ./scripts/quality-gate/baseline-tightened.sh "$before" "$file" || verdict=1
done < <(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD -- 'packages/*/.gate-baseline.json')
exit "$verdict"

pipelines.name: Auto-format master

steps.name: Apply dotnet format to this push's changed files
steps.run:
before="${{ github.event.before }}"
# All-zero SHA (new branch) or a commit we don't have (history rewrite):
# fall back to the last commit rather than erroring.
if [[ "$before" =~ ^0+$ ]] || ! git cat-file -e "$before" 2>/dev/null; then
  before="HEAD~1"
fi
./scripts/quality-gate/format-suggest.sh packages --base-ref "$before"

pipelines.name: Mutation

steps.name: Mutate changed packages
steps.run:
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD -- 'packages/**/*.cs' \
  | sed -E 's#(packages/[^/]+)/.*#\1#' | sort -u \
  | while read -r pkg; do
      cfg=$(ls "$pkg"/*.Tests/stryker-config.json 2>/dev/null) || continue
      ( cd "$(dirname "$cfg")" && dotnet stryker --since:origin/master )
    done
